title: DeLonge–Podesta disclosure meeting with Robert Weiss

tellings.quote: this meeting where all these guys are at this meeting in in uh 2016 in January

plain: In January 2016, the story goes, a group of men met in Washington to talk about the government making public what it knows about UFOs. Among them were the musician Tom DeLonge, the political adviser John Podesta and a man named Robert Weiss. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron describes the meeting, which he connects to the Podesta emails, a set of Podesta's private emails that later became public, and he offers it as a sign that people close to power were working on disclosure.
